设计意图： Combines volume abnormality (z-score of log volume over 20 days weighted by range ratio) with lagged volume asymmetry (ratio of up-day to down-day volume EWMA over 10 days). The product amplifies the asymmetry signal when volume is abnormal, capturing extreme volatility events with delayed volume adjustment to price direction. 📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

abs(ts_zscore(log(volume),20)) * (high-low)/close * EWMA_up_vol/EWMA_down_vol
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：log(volume) → 计算自然对数（底数为e）
  2. 步骤2：ts_zscore(v1(log)) → 窗口 20 的n 期滚动 Z-Score：(x − 均值) / 标准差
  3. 步骤3：abs(v2(ts_zscore)) → 计算绝对值
  4. 步骤4：subtract(high, low) → 减法：x - y
  5. 步骤5：multiply(v3(abs), v4(subtract)) → 乘法：x × y
  6. 步骤6：divide(v5(multiply), close) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  7. 步骤7：multiply(v6(divide), EWMA_up_vol) → 乘法：x × y
  8. 步骤8：divide(v7(multiply), EWMA_down_vol) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_zscoren 期滚动 Z-Score：(x − 均值) / 标准差
EWMA_down_vol下行量 EWMA（close<open 日的成交量指数加权均）
EWMA_up_vol上行量 EWMA（close≥open 日的成交量指数加权均）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 log_vol：np.log(volume + 1)
  2. 计算 rolling_mean：log_vol.rolling(window=20).mean()
  3. 计算 rolling_std：log_vol.rolling(window=20).std()
  4. 计算 z_score：(log_vol - rolling_mean) / rolling_std
  5. 计算 abnormality：np.abs(z_score)
  6. 计算 range_ratio：(high - low) / close
  7. 计算 vol_abnorm：abnormality * range_ratio
  8. 计算 up_day：close >= open
  9. 计算 vol_up：volume.where(up_day, 0)
  10. 计算 vol_down：volume.where(~up_day, 0)
  11. 计算 span：10
  12. 计算 ewma_up：vol_up.ewm(span=span, adjust=False).mean()
  13. 计算 ewma_down：vol_down.ewm(span=span, adjust=False).mean()
  14. 计算 ratio：np.where(ewma_down > 0, ewma_up / ewma_down, 1.0)
  15. 计算 factor：vol_abnorm * ratio

"kw">class="kw">def factor_abnormality_asymmetry(df): df_copy = df.copy() log_vol = np.log(df_copy["str">'volume'] + 1) rolling_mean = log_vol.rolling(window=20).mean() rolling_std = log_vol.rolling(window=20).std() z_score = (log_vol - rolling_mean) / rolling_std abnormality = np.abs(z_score) range_ratio = (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low']) / df_copy["str">'close'] vol_abnorm = abnormality * range_ratio up_day = df_copy["str">'close'] >= df_copy["str">'open'] vol_up = df_copy["str">'volume'].where(up_day, 0) vol_down = df_copy["str">'volume'].where(~up_day, 0) span = 10 ewma_up = vol_up.ewm(span=span, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() ewma_down = vol_down.ewm(span=span, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() ratio = np.where(ewma_down > 0, ewma_up / ewma_down, 1.0) factor = vol_abnorm * ratio df_copy["str">'factor_abnormality_asymmetry'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_abnormality_asymmetry']
